parsed.why: No trans-specific offence or documented targeting, but also no protections naming gender identity, no document remedy, thin sourcing and general stigmatisation — no acceptance evidence to lift it further.

Documented traveler-facing friction: airport stops, passport medical-exam demands, railway police groping under 'gender check' — but assessed non-systemic, with constitutional gender-identity equality and courts granting relief.

No criminalisation or state targeting, official Pride endorsement, 2024 decrees explicitly protecting trans people; offset by documented service discrimination and community violence mostly resident-facing, plus no general equality law.

State deportation of foreign nationals suspected of being gay or trans without charges, morality-law arrests, app entrapment targeting trans women, coerced examinations, LGR closed — tier-2 state targeting reaching visitors directly.

Criminal statutes reaching intimate contact, no gender-marker change, documented state campaigns including custody violence — but prosecution recency unproven, with a court win, health-ministry care protections and strong legal-aid infrastructure.
